rationale: Re-verified 2026-10-21: the vulnerable JaegerPropagator.extract is only reachable once the propagator is registered, and the telemetry wiring this transitive copy serves (app/vendor/domain-events-infra/src/Infra/OpenTelemetry/OpenTelemetrySDK.ts line 61 and its built dist/src/Infra/OpenTelemetry/OpenTelemetrySDK.js line 44, the vendored domain-events-infra the bundled home server depends on) passes a single explicit textMapPropagator of AWSXRayPropagator, which replaces the default propagator set rather than adding to it; git grep finds no OTEL_PROPAGATORS value anywhere in the tracked tree except this rationale, so nothing re-adds jaeger. Not resolvable by a pin: the registry shows the patched 2.9.0 depending on @opentelemetry/core 2.9.0, while this copy's dependent sdk-trace-node@1.19.0 pins core 1.19.0, so adopting it crosses OpenTelemetry major families inside a published patched dependency of the app lock domain — a family migration, not a keyed resolution.
